title: Diagonal Gowers inner average
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$ and a real-valued function $f\colon\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, define its diagonal Gowers inner average of order $k$ to be the Gowers inner average of the family that takes the value $f(x)$ at every pair $(s,x)$.
